name: mojulo
description: The mojulo plugin: a local 3D compiler MCP server for coding agents, published by its maintainer from the zombico/mojulo repository.

plugins.name: mojulo
plugins.description: A 3D compiler for coding agents: objects, walkable worlds and games as small recipes compiled back byte-for-byte and emitted to HTML, Godot, Blender, STL/3MF. Runs the mojulo MCP server locally with npx; no account, no API key, no external telemetry.
